rules.ifDeleted: The model is gone unless you have the source project or another copy.

rules.title: Archive (ZIP)
rules.summary: Compressed archive; often a download you already extracted
rules.whatItIs: A compressed archive. Often it is a download that was already extracted, or a backup.
rules.whyBig: It holds whatever was packed into it.
rules.ifDeleted: Its contents are gone unless they were extracted or exist elsewhere.
rules.saferAlternative: Open it to check whether its contents exist elsewhere before deleting.

rules.whyBig: Model weights are often several GB.
rules.ifDeleted: Tools that use this model fail until it is downloaded again; a model you trained yourself is lost.

rules.title: Partial download
rules.summary: Unfinished download; safe to delete if the download is no longer running
rules.whatItIs: A file that is still being downloaded, or whose download stopped (Firefox, wget, many download tools). It is renamed when the download finishes.
rules.whyBig: It grows up to the full size of the download.
rules.ifDeleted: The unfinished download is lost and has to start again; an active download fails.
rules.saferAlternative: Cancel or resume the download in the program that started it.

rules.title: Database file (SQLite)
rules.summary: Database of a program; deleting can lose its data or settings
rules.whatItIs: A database file a program keeps its data in: history, settings, indexes or content.
rules.whyBig: It grows with what the program stores.
rules.ifDeleted: The program loses the data stored in it; caches are rebuilt, real data is gone.
